note: Members of a Submitted Profile Resolution Artifact Collection, read by intlify_config. An independent implementation decides from each member alone what it declares, whether it establishes an exact-reference tuple and which, whether its integrity holds, how its body admission ends, and its canonical bytes; checks the members whose semantic digests must agree or differ, the spellings that must frame to one canonical body, the members that must stay unequal, and the texts a JSON number makes unrepresentable; orders the members within one tuple and the members without a tuple by their canonical bodies; decides for each change to an admitted member's content whether the result is still the kind's closed content; and checks that each reference names its member's tuple. The contents are test values.
